text:
ashley: quick sync 1 we need a lightweight rule set for SI co-sell leads coming from cloud marketplaces and HW partners. getting duplicates in SFDC.
jorge: main pain is marketplace leads showing up as both partner & inbound web form. who owns first touch?
maria: current informal rule is first-touch owns for 14 days but its not enforced. we should codify SI flows.
kelvin: proposal: partner owns discovery + scheduling for 21 days if they registered in portal; otherwise field AE can claim.
ashley: draft routing rules: 
- partner_portal registration -> partner owns, exclusive claim 21d
- redwood.com with partner_referral tag -> partner has 7-day validation window, then AE owns
- duplicates: auto-merge on email match, tag as partner-claimed; ops audit trail required
jorge: escalation: if partner hasn't engaged in 7 days, auto-ping AE; AE can auto-claim after 7 more days. >$250k ARR -> immediate field-owner assignment.
lisa: legal check: add consent checkbox on partner registration to allow Redwood AEs to contact and to share data with partner reps.
maria: ops todo: add label taxonomy [partner-portal, partner-referral, hw-channel, marketplace-sku] + partner_engaged_ts field.
partners-bot: new partner portal entries posted to #partner-ingest at 1968000025
kelvin: technical note: intake worker pseudocode we discussed:
```
if lead.source == "partner_portal":
  assign(lead, partner.owner)
  set_claim_expiry(lead, now + 21d)
elif lead.tags contains "partner-referral":
  assign(lead, partner.owner)
  set_claim_expiry(lead, now + 7d)
else:
  assign(lead, AE.oncall)
```
ashley: also add a QoS rule for HW SKUs: auto-cc SE + partner AM when sku indicates field install/support.
maria: i'll draft a one-page playbook and post to confluence, will ping this thread.
jorge: can we add a small SLA metric: partner_response_ts, measured as first reply within 72 hours? ops can surface SLA misses to partner AMs.
kelvin: will wire SE auto-cc based on sku prefix and add partner_response_ts to intake payload.
lisa: i'll craft the consent language and share snippet.
ashley: timeline: draft EOD wednesday, feedback by friday. if :thumbsup: we ship minimal automation next week.
jorge: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
partners-bot: 7-day follow-up reminder scheduled for 1968006041
ashley: thanks everyone 1 keeping this lean so we can iterate. i'll post final play + checklist for partner onboarding.
